about.title: About Let Us Massage
about.p1: Welcome to Let Us Massage — a place where your wellbeing comes first. Located in the heart of Lund, we offer professional massage therapy in a calm, welcoming environment.
about.p2: Founded by Ioulietta Refene, our studio is dedicated to helping you relax, recover, and feel your best. Whether you're looking to ease tension, relieve pain, or simply treat yourself, we're here for you.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Each treatment is tailored to your individual needs

items.name: Classic Massage
items.description: A full-body relaxing massage using smooth, flowing strokes to ease tension and improve circulation.

items.name: Deep Tissue Massage
items.description: Targets deep layers of muscle to release chronic tension and relieve pain.

items.name: Relaxation Massage
items.description: An extended treatment focused on complete relaxation, leaving you refreshed and renewed.

items.name: Hot Stone Massage
items.description: Warm stones are used to deeply relax muscles and improve energy flow throughout the body.
